modules.title: 固定订单怎样在测试前准备、结束后清理
数据与 Fixture 分别负责什么

items.title: 测试数据提供明确的输入和状态
items.text: 例如“已注册用户、购物车有两件商品、优惠券有效”是用例所需的起点。固定、可读的数据让失败结果可以被复查，而不是每次随机出现。

items.title: Fixture 让每次运行回到同一起点
items.text: Fixture 将创建账号、填入订单、启动依赖和结束后清理等步骤整理为可复用机制。这样多个用例能少写重复准备，也不会因上一次残留而互相污染。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 测试数据与 Fixture 相关但不相同：数据是具体值和状态样本，Fixture 是准备和清理这些前提的机制。随机生成一次输入或手动留下的数据库记录，不能替代可重复的 Fixture。

lessonPractice.title: “测试前创建普通用户和一张待支付订单，测试后删除它们”属于哪种测试准备方式？

options.label: Fixture，因为它规定了用例开始前的准备和结束后的清理
options.feedback: 对。用户姓名、订单金额等具体内容是测试数据；创建和清理的可复用流程是 Fixture。

options.label: 只是测试数据，因为里面有用户和订单
options.feedback: 这里描述的不只是值，还包括每次运行前后如何建立和还原状态。

options.label: 生产初始化数据，不需要在测试后清理
options.feedback: 测试前提应避免污染真实生产数据，且应能恢复稳定起点。

en.title: Which test setup creates a regular user and a pending-payment order before each test, then removes them afterward?

options.label: A fixture, because it defines setup before and cleanup after a case
options.feedback: Correct. The user name and order amount are test data; the reusable setup and cleanup flow is the fixture.

options.label: Only test data, because it contains a user and order
options.feedback: It describes not only values but how state is created and restored around every run.

options.label: Production seed data that needs no cleanup
options.feedback: Test prerequisites should not pollute real production data and should restore a stable starting point.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为订单测试建立 Fixture：每次测试前创建固定用户和待支付订单，结束后清理。把具体测试数据与准备/清理步骤分开写；连续运行两次，确认第二次不受第一次影响。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Create an order-test fixture: before each test make a fixed user and pending-payment order, then clean up afterward. Keep concrete test data separate from setup/cleanup steps; run twice and confirm the second run is not affected by the first.

learning.assumes: You know a second test run should not be changed by data left from the first.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish data values from a reusable mechanism that prepares and resets those values for tests.

modules.title: How fixed orders are prepared before and cleaned after a test
What data and fixtures each own

items.title: Test data supplies clear input and state
items.text: A registered user, cart with two items, and valid coupon are starting conditions. Fixed readable data makes failures reviewable instead of randomly different every run.

items.title: A fixture restores the same starting point
items.text: Fixtures organize account creation, order setup, dependency startup, and cleanup into a reusable mechanism. Cases write less duplicated setup and do not contaminate each other with leftovers.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Test data and fixtures are related but distinct: data are values and state samples; fixtures prepare and clean up those prerequisites. One random input or a manually left database row cannot replace a repeatable fixture.

distinctions.label: Test double
distinctions.text: A {c:test-fixture} gives tests a repeatable starting point and cleans up afterward. A {c:test-double} replaces the behavior of a real dependency.
